Description: Size and eccentricity of the face in each scene. How the values were computed is not documented in this release. Their units are not documented either.

size_locs.Description: One row per image, in the order of stimulus_order.tsv. Column 1: face size, used as the predictor 'Face size' (FaceSize). Column 2: face eccentricity, used as 'Face ecc.' (FaceEcc). Column 3: image number 1-120, equal to image_index + 1.
